title: polyp-loco-conformal: code for a leave-one-centre-out evaluation of conformal risk control of the polyp miss rate (PolypGen, YOLO11)
description: Code for the data audit, video clustering, leave-one-centre-out splits, YOLO11 training and prediction export, detection evaluation, conformal risk control analyses and figures of a multi-centre evaluation of conformal risk control of the polyp miss rate on PolypGen, with an external check on CVC-ClinicDB. No images, masks or annotation-derived files of either dataset are included.
